Cyclone Barun hits Cox's Bazar coast, 400,000 evacuated

Cyclone Barun struck the Cox's Bazar coast on Tuesday morning with winds reaching 120 km/h, and about 400,000 people were evacuated to cyclone shelters before landfall, according to the disaster management ministry.

Local administrators said power was cut across the district and several embankments were breached by the storm surge. Hospitals were told to keep emergency staff on duty.

The weather office expects the cyclone to weaken to a depression by Wednesday afternoon.
